sources.CR41: Auchinleck, operations despatch, London Gazette 38177, pre-Crusader enemy order of battle and dispositions: Afrika Division (90th Light) and Trento were present in eastern Cyrenaica by mid-November 1941. The game counters aggregate each formation; exact manpower and hexes are estimates. https://www.ibiblio.org/hyperwar/UN/UK/LondonGazette/38177.pdf
sources.SA41: Auchinleck, operations despatch, London Gazette 38177: by early December the 2nd South African Division, including 3rd and 6th Brigades, relieved Indian formations and joined Eighth Army's reorganised force. The 2 December entry and game manpower are estimates. https://www.ibiblio.org/hyperwar/UN/UK/LondonGazette/38177.pdf

name: Operation Crusader: 18 November–31 December 1941 (linked research)

aim.cw: Defeat the Axis mobile force, secure the frontier and open the Sidi Rezegh–Belhamed corridor to Tobruk. If Tobruk has fallen in the played campaign, recapture it; the offensive need not follow the historical sequence.
aim.axis: Keep the Tobruk corridor closed, protect the frontier and preserve the mobile force. Exploit a weakened Commonwealth position wherever the played campaign permits.

about: Campaign-only Crusader trial. All surviving units, positions, losses, stocks and control come from the played 17 November state. New Zealand, South African, corps and army-tank formations become available on the first turn as a coarse field-readiness abstraction, with estimated strengths and Commonwealth-base entry rather than an asserted historical map placement. The Axis Afrika Division and Trento are also represented from the first turn; their exact game strengths and placement are estimates. A compact 2nd South African formation becomes available in early December with estimated strength and entry. 32nd Army Tank Brigade enters at friendly-held Tobruk or from the Commonwealth base if it has fallen. The five-hex Sidi Rezegh–Belhamed–Tobruk route is a map-scale corridor, not an exact historical road. The independent Crusader scenario remains a separate historical opening. The linked chapter lacks validated serviceability, reserve, relief and repair modelling.

withdrawals.note: The last Australian battalion left Tobruk on 10 December in the historical campaign. Only the relieved battalion remnant near friendly-held Tobruk leaves; an unrelieved 20th Brigade stays in the played campaign.
